# Foundations of Interrupted Time Series Analysis

## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Explain the principles of interrupted time series (ITS) analysis.
- Identify research questions suitable for ITS.
- Define the intervention, outcome, and study period.
- Understand the strengths and limitations of ITS designs.

## Introduction

Interrupted time series analysis is a quasi-experimental method used to evaluate whether an intervention is associated with a change in an outcome over time.
